license_note: The repository ships no separate LICENSE file; the pinned model-card metadata declares Apache-2.0 with an explicit license link to the canonical Apache-2.0 text, and the NVFP4 variant declares the same grant.

license_evidence.scope: Inkling repository weights, Safetensors checkpoints, tokenizer, and chat template

access_boundary: This record represents the Inkling weight release announced July 15, 2026, a multimodal MoE accepting text, image, and audio. The Inkling-Small release, quantized variants, and independent hosts are separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated open multimodal weights at frontier scale with a detailed first-party card, evaluation, and safety material
Day-zero vLLM, SGLang, and transformers support with BF16 and NVFP4 variants
tradeoffs: The repository ships no LICENSE file; Apache-2.0 rests on pinned model-card metadata
BF16 serving needs roughly 2TB of VRAM across multiple nodes, and no dated deprecation or lifecycle statement exists

evidence.label: Official model page, model card, or weight repository
